claims: Life's Still Unfair is a four-episode reboot.
Life's Still Unfair premieres on Hulu and Disney+ on April 10, 2026.
Frankie Muniz is confirmed to return as Malcolm.
Bryan Cranston is confirmed to return as Hal.
Jane Kaczmarek is confirmed to return as Lois.
Emy Coligado is confirmed to return as Piama.
Caleb Ellsworth-Clark plays the adult Dewey.
Keeley Karsten plays Malcolm’s daughter Leah.
Kiana Madeira plays Malcolm’s girlfriend Tristan.
Life's Still Unfair is produced by Ryan Murphy.
Life's Still Unfair is a four-part miniseries.
The reboot plot is set two decades after the original series.
The original Malcolm in the Middle series aired from 2000 to 2006.
Malcolm returns home for his parents Hal and Lois's 40th anniversary party in the reboot plot.
The special event premieres on Hulu on April 10, 2026.
